en-US.title: Oiaai
en-US.subtitle: Record, share, collaborate
en-US.description:
Oiaai makes clear async communication simple. Record with your iPhone camera or import videos and images, upload them to get a shareable link, and keep work moving without another meeting.

Use Oiaai for iPhone to:

• Record high-quality camera and microphone video
• Import media from Photos or Files
• Create and share links
• Browse personal, organization, and space libraries
• Watch recordings with native playback controls
• Manage link visibility, titles, and passwords
• Follow comments, reactions, and viewer analytics
• Import existing Loom videos
• Pick up work started in Oiaai for desktop or web

A free Oiaai account includes recordings up to five minutes. Existing Oiaai Pro subscribers get unlimited recording time and advanced collaboration features.

Oiaai is open source and built for creators, teams, educators, and anyone who wants a faster way to show, explain, and share.
en-US.promoText: Record or import a video, turn it into a shareable link, and stay on top of comments, reactions, analytics, and team spaces from your iPhone.
